annotations.title: What a reader wrote in the margins

description:
Only the notes one reader wrote in their own words in the margins of their books (not bare underlines or scores), from the Marginalia Corpus, optionally narrowed to one author, one title or a word. Each note comes with the printed passage it sits beside, the page, whether the source attributes the hand to the reader with certainty, and its cite line. Text a source withholds under its terms is counted, not quoted.

Example questions:
- "What did Melville write in the margins of his Milton?"
- "What notes did John Dee leave in his books?"
- "Derrida's handwritten notes on Rousseau"

author.description: Optional: the author whose books carry the notes, e.g. 'Milton'.

contains.description: Optional: only notes or passages containing these words.

own_hand_only.description: Optional: true keeps only notes the source attributes to the reader's own hand with certainty.

title.description: Optional: words from the book's title.
